about.intro: Window to Truth is a chatbot that provides reliable and insightful information about the Colombian conflict and peace process.
about.how1: Ask about the Colombian conflict, peace agreements, or key events. The chatbot provides accurate context using official data from the Colombian Truth Commission.
about.how2: Some responses can take close to 20 seconds. Please be patient while the chatbot processes your request.
about.how3: Our answers include references to ensure the information you receive is reliable and precise. We summarize complex issues to make them easier to understand while providing the necessary depth. You are welcome to ask follow-up questions, and the conversation can continue exploring related topics.
about.commission1: The Commission for the Clarification of Truth, Coexistence, and Non-Repetition was established as part of the 2016 Peace Agreement between the Colombian government and the FARC.
about.commission2: Their work between 2018 and 2022 has been crucial for understanding the armed conflict and promoting reconciliation throughout Colombia.

landing.title: How Window to Truth answers your questions
landing.subtitle: Follow a question through the system: from the Commission's documents to vectors, retrieval and a cited answer. Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom and click any component to learn more.
landing.canvasLabel: Interactive 3D diagram of the cev-rag architecture

stageHints.ingest: Reports, testimonies and documents from the Truth Commission archive are loaded.
stageHints.chunk: Each document is split into fragments small enough to be compared precisely.
stageHints.embed: An embedding model turns every fragment into a 3,072-dimension vector that captures its meaning.
stageHints.store: The vectors are indexed in Milvus, a vector database built for similarity search.
stageHints.query: Your question is turned into a vector with the same embedding model.
stageHints.retrieve: Milvus finds the fragments closest in meaning to your question (top-k by cosine similarity).
stageHints.generate: The language model writes an answer using only those fragments, citing each source.

documents.title: Truth Commission documents
documents.body: The archive of the Commission for the Clarification of Truth, Coexistence and Non-Repetition: the final report, thematic volumes, testimonies and supporting documents. Their metadata (title, year, publisher, ISBN, page, URL) travels with every fragment so answers can cite them.

embedding.title: Embedding module
embedding.body: Every fragment, and later every question, is converted into a dense vector with OpenAI's embedding model. Texts with similar meaning end up close to each other in this high-dimensional space, even when they use different words.

vectorStore.title: Vector store (Milvus)
vectorStore.body: Milvus stores the vectors together with their source metadata and indexes them with HNSW for fast approximate nearest-neighbour search using cosine similarity.

query.title: Your question
query.body: Questions are sent from this interface to the FastAPI backend, validated and embedded. The conversation history (last messages) is kept so you can ask follow-up questions.

llm.title: Answer generation (LLM)
llm.body: The language model receives your question and decides, through tool calling, which information to retrieve. It answers exclusively from the retrieved fragments, in your language, with numbered citations, and it avoids revealing victims' names or locations that could put people at risk.
